related.title: Mars Express 火星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若 ln(n) 對高度明顯彎曲，報告分段 H，不把它直接當作逃逸率。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: If ln(n) versus altitude is curved, report piecewise H and do not label it an escape rate. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 把雙程雷達延遲換算成介質厚度，明確保留介電常數歧義。
related.differenceEn: Convert two-way radar delay into layer thickness while retaining dielectric ambiguity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成高度差 40 km，低處密度 100、高處 20，密度單位相同。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：H=40/ln(100/20)。 結果約 24.8534 km。等溫靜力近似 n2/n1=exp(−Δh/H)；僅在溫度、成分及重力近似固定時成立。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成地表與深部回波相差 10 μs，c=3×10⁸ m/s，εr=4。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=3×10⁸×10⁻⁵/(2sqrt(4))。 結果約 750 m。均勻無色散介質中 d=cΔt/(2sqrt(εr))；亮回波不能單獨證明液態水。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic altitude difference is 40 km, with lower density 100 and upper density 20 in identical units. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: H=40/ln(100/20). Result ≈ 24.8534 km. The isothermal hydrostatic approximation n2/n1=exp(−Δh/H) requires approximately fixed temperature, composition and gravity.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic surface-to-subsurface delay is 10 μs, c=3×10⁸ m/s and εr=4. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=3×10⁸×10⁻⁵/(2sqrt(4)). Result ≈ 750 m. For a uniform nondispersive medium d=cΔt/(2sqrt(εr)); a bright echo alone cannot establish liquid water.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若 ln(n) 對高度明顯彎曲，報告分段 H，不把它直接當作逃逸率。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: If ln(n) versus altitude is curved, report piecewise H and do not label it an escape rate. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 在有限像元尺度下估算坡度與高度誤差對場址分級的影響。
related.differenceEn: Estimate slope at finite pixel scale and assess how height error affects site classification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成高度差 40 km，低處密度 100、高處 20，密度單位相同。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：H=40/ln(100/20)。 結果約 24.8534 km。等溫靜力近似 n2/n1=exp(−Δh/H)；僅在溫度、成分及重力近似固定時成立。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成相鄰高程差 12 m、水平間距 60 m，水平距離視為無誤差。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：s=12/60，百分坡度=100s。 結果約 20 %。局部坡度比 s=Δh/Δx；這是尺度依賴的平均值，不代表像元內最大坡度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic altitude difference is 40 km, with lower density 100 and upper density 20 in identical units. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: H=40/ln(100/20). Result ≈ 24.8534 km. The isothermal hydrostatic approximation n2/n1=exp(−Δh/H) requires approximately fixed temperature, composition and gravity.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic elevation difference is 12 m over 60 m horizontally, treating horizontal distance as exact. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: s=12/60; percent grade=100s. Result ≈ 20 %. Local slope ratio s=Δh/Δx is a scale-dependent average, not the maximum subpixel slope.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
